run_route_guide_client: run the gRPC route guide client to test all four RPC types against localhost:50051
guide_get_feature: use the gRPC stub to fetch a single feature by its latitude and longitude coordinates
guide_list_features: query the gRPC server for all features within a rectangular geographic bounding box
guide_record_route: stream random route points to the gRPC server and receive a trip summary with distance
guide_route_chat: send bidirectional streaming RouteNote messages to the gRPC server and print received responses
